published_title: Endor Ops  Speed Drains  Crazy Activation
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Mad Dog''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]] list on DeckTech in September 2000.
description: This deck has good activation, speed draining and good battling.
cards: posted: All Power to Weapons x3
notes: Qty 57 as published: the section headers add up to 59 (Objective + 58), and the 'Starships (24)' section lists only 22 (5 Dreadnaught, 6 TIE Interceptor, 6 TIE Vanguard, 3 TIE Defender Mark I, The Emperor's Sword, The Emperor's Shield). Dested as posted.
Posted 'Battle Plan' (a Light Side Effect) on this Dark list dested its Dark counterpart Battle Order (Endor Effect).

'Starting (7)': Endor, Endor: Bunker, Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) (posted 'Endor Landing Platform'), Prepared Defenses, You Cannot Hide Forever, Mobilization Points and Battle Plan (dested Battle Order), with the Objective. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (unique, posted 'Mara Jade') is listed x2. Posted 'Commander Merjek' dested Commander Merrejk; 'Wakeelmiu' Wakeelmui; 'Drednaught' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'Tie Defender Mark 1' TIE Defender Mark I; 'Perimiter Patrol' Perimeter Patrol; 'Resistence' Resistance (the Special Edition Effect in 2000, not the Reflections III Defensive Shield).
The post says the deck 'has been Undefeated at tournaments so far' (no event named). The poster later posted 'Endor Ops Speed Drains Crazy Activation v 1 0' (17 September 2000), already live.
